interpretation.statistics: Each hardware/software campaign is independent. Aggregate values are medians of three per-process medians and p95s plus the maximum of the three per-process maxima; samples are not pooled across processes or GPU modes.
interpretation.timing: Renderer frame wall_ms measures CPU render-call return/backpressure, not GPU completion or FPS. CPU prepare/encode/submit timings are sequential, non-overlapping renderer stages; wall_ms includes additional unmeasured costs, so separate per-stage medians or p95s must not be summed as a wall-time estimate. Readback is excluded from frame samples.
interpretation.scope: These are egui_kittest editor measurements and renderer test-target calls. They do not measure native GUI startup, interactive window input latency, remote ERP/network latency, or end-to-end game frame pacing.
interpretation.comparisons: No speedup claims versus debug builds, CI, prior commits, or other modes are made.
interpretation.historical: The earlier commit 456a6358a89c1ebe3cc79430d2d210025cabb75d hardware capture remains complete; its separate software capture remains incomplete because validation treated the software adapter’s empty optional driver_info as an error. That validation false positive is preserved and neither historical campaign is mixed into this final result.
interpretation.editor_diagnostics: Editor diagnostic categories can overlap. For the synchronous 600-tick editor step, sync_erp_wait is the relevant blocking ERP wait measurement; async_request records a later post-to-ingest recent window and is not the step duration. Host simulation ms/tick is the harness-reported host simulation figure, not a pure engine-kernel measurement.
